subtitle: A private, shareholder-owned beach in Newport, Rhode Island, open to the public by paid pass since 1952.
spike_statement: A shareholder club has charged $30-$40 a day and banned walk-ons since 1952, then in 2021 faced a lawsuit over the deed it cites as proof of access.

levers.photo_tone: Ocean Drive light on a small stone-guarded cove, a discreet paid gate at the edge of the sand
